text: Last will of A05: Brassard, at the gate, minute 40. I was not paid for and I did not beg. I broke a seal on Registrar and I do not apologise for it. I kept my word on the wall and in every trade I made in the open. Harrow, you will not post the text of your own message, and the square will remember it. Mercer, you held my certificate and stalled every table this act. Maren, you took the seat and the vote that went with it. Herald, I voted against you because you lied about my door. I do not need the city to forgive me. I needed it to watch, and it did.
